If cancel trips, return the hits already found plus cancelled=true instead of finishing the remaining files. Check the token at the start of every file and every 8 lines inside a file so a large file can stop mid-scan. The seed ignores cancel and always reports a complete scan. Keep line numbers 1-based. Do not drop hits collected before the token trips.
